font-size.comment: Midden-Delfland root rem base. middendelfland.nl sets the html font-size to var(--bodyFontSize) = 1.12rem, so 1rem = 17.92px site-wide and ALL rem-based tokens scale by 1.12. Kept under the conduction key so it emits --conduction-root-font-size (same variable name across all themes). Relative unit so the user's browser font-size / zoom is respected (accessibility). Consuming apps apply this variable as the font-size on html/body.
